_comment: gateway-mcp-proxy (REQ-MCPX-001..003): an endpoint of targetType mcp puts an outside MCP tool server (streamable HTTP) behind the gateway, under the consumer keys, limits, quota and call log that guard a REST API. The answer, an event stream included, is relayed as it arrives up to mcpMaxStreamSeconds; mcpToolLimits gives a tool its own limit per consumer; the call log names the JSON-RPC method and the tool, and stores tool arguments only when mcpStoreArguments is set. Seeds a disabled example tool server and its endpoint.

targetType.description: Polymorphic target kind: `register/schema`, `api`, `a2a` (a source holding an A2A agent, its agent card answered pointing at the endpoint), `mcp` (a source that is an MCP tool server over streamable HTTP, relayed with its session headers and event streams), `job`, `synchronization`.

mcpToolLimits.title: Tool limits
mcpToolLimits.description: For an mcp endpoint: a rate limit per tool, counted per consumer on top of the consumer's own limits. Maps a tool name to the number of calls allowed in a window of seconds; a call over it gets HTTP 429 with a JSON-RPC error naming the tool.

window.title: Window (seconds)
window.description: The length of the window, in seconds.

mcpMaxStreamSeconds.title: Maximum stream duration (seconds)
mcpMaxStreamSeconds.description: For an mcp endpoint: the longest an answer is relayed, an event stream included, after which integriq closes it. Every open stream holds a web server worker until it ends.

mcpStoreArguments.title: Store tool arguments
mcpStoreArguments.description: For an mcp endpoint: keep the request body, and so the tool arguments, in the call log after its usual redaction. Off by default, because tool arguments may carry personal data.

mcpMethod.title: MCP method
mcpMethod.description: For a call through an mcp endpoint: the JSON-RPC method, such as initialize, tools/list or tools/call.

mcpTool.title: MCP tool
mcpTool.description: For a tools/call through an mcp endpoint: the name of the tool called.

objects.name: Example MCP tool server
objects.description: An example of an outside MCP tool server reached over streamable HTTP. Disabled: set the location to your tool server and its own credential, then enable it. The endpoint mcp/example relays to the path mcp/example on this location.

objects.name: Example MCP tool server
objects.description: Publishes the example MCP tool server through the gateway: consumers call it with their API key, and the call log names each tool called. The tool search is limited to 10 calls a minute per consumer. Its source is disabled until it points at a real tool server.
